deliverables.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: finished landscape 16:9 game interface art-direction mockup, a single screenshot without device frame.
Primary request: redesign the attached real Glimblehop mobile puzzle screenshot into a modern, airy dialogue interface. A large expressive speaking character, minimal panels, generous spacing and clear hierarchy. This is a design concept, not a new game level.
Input images: Image 1 is the gameplay edit target: retain the actual board, camera, environment and little playable Tish. Image 2 is the character identity reference: Luma is the middle character. Image 3 is the accepted illustration style reference.
Keep the actual eight cream tiles in the same connected route, Tish on the lower-left starting tile with his gold selection ring, wooden bridge and gate at the upper-right exit. Do not add or hide tiles. Keep the visible gameplay environment in its existing 3D diorama style.
Remove all existing heavy wooden UI frames, the large left hint rectangle, detached hint button and the bulky bottom move panel. Replace with one clean thin top HUD and ONE broad ivory lower dialogue-and-action surface, rounded 24px corners, very subtle shadow, ample padding. No nested card frames. Keep the board and start token completely unobstructed above the bottom surface.
Top HUD: small level title "Калитка у дома" aligned left, small leaf icon with "0/1", understated "Ваш ход", minimal pause and gear icons aligned right. Warm ivory text over the background with only a soft local readability gradient, no wood plaques.
Bottom surface occupies about the bottom 19% of the screen, with side margins. Content in left 76%: small teal speaker label "Совет Лумы", then the exact dialogue in modern rounded humanist sans-serif, dark forest charcoal, large and readable:
"Теперь нажми Тиша на подсвеченной плите. Он сам сделает выбранный шаг."
Below, one slim action row with a small pale-gold "Шаг 1" chip and a compact clearly actionable warm-gold "Тиш" button. Small dismiss x near the label, no large Close or Hide Training buttons. Do not add explanatory headings or extra words.
Luma on the rightmost 20% as a large free silhouette from head to hips, ears and braid fully visible, head beginning at about 42% screen height, lower body cropped by screen edge. Not inside a frame or circular avatar. She leans slightly towards the board, gently gestures toward Tish on the left and speaks with a friendly lightly open mouth. Olive-green skin, warm amber eyes, chestnut braid, pointed coral inner ears, turquoise triangular kerchief with small leaf clasp, cream blouse, practical brown leather vest. Match the middle reference character and accepted comics; adult cozy goblin proportions. Keep her head below the exit tile and her hands out of the interactive tile route. She is an illustrated UI overlay, not a second board pawn.
Style: polished cozy adventure game with contemporary editorial mobile UI, airy warm cream, forest charcoal and subtle teal/gold accents. Crisp typography. Characters rendered with the rich soft 3D storybook finish of the references.
Avoid: wooden UI borders, several competing windows, tiny portrait, serif body text, neon, glassy low-contrast text, new board route, extra pawns, watermark, device frame, annotation labels.

Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: finished portrait 9:16 story-dialogue screenshot for Glimblehop, without a device frame.
Primary request: create the companion story screen to the modern airy gameplay dialogue concept. Show one immersive comic story moment filling the entire screen, large expressive speaking characters rather than tiny framed portraits, a very light minimal interface.
Input images: Image 1 is the accepted S00 storyboard; ONLY its MIDDLE panel is the scene and event reference. Image 2 is the cast identity reference: Tish left, Luma middle. Image 3 is the new gameplay dialogue screen, used ONLY for UI palette, clean sans typography and gentle ivory surfaces.
Story event: the magpie Kloch flies upward and to the right, carrying the stolen round amber glass lens in its beak. The lens is a separate round amber disc, not an entire lantern. The large wooden wedding lantern remains attached to the flower-decorated village post on the left. Tish reaches toward the bird in surprise; Luma is behind him, startled. Keep their established colors and outfits, no additional characters.
Composition: one full-bleed scene, no comic grid, no outer frame, no app window. Cozy forest village decorated for a wedding, flowers, cloth garlands, warm golden morning sunshine. Kloch with black-white plumage, blue wings, green leaf hat and tiny brown satchel in the upper third; the stolen lens visible and clear. Tish dominates the lower-middle foreground as a large waist-up/three-quarter living character, head and reaching hand fully visible above the dialogue surface. His eyes look upward to the bird; slightly open speaking mouth. Olive-green skin, chestnut tuft, coral neck scarf, brown stitched trail outfit, crossbody satchel, pointed pink-inner ears with a small notch in his own left ear. Luma behind on the right, turquoise scarf, leaf clasp, chestnut braid, cream shirt and brown leather vest; large enough to read her surprised expression, smaller than Tish. Preserve the accepted warm textured high-quality 3D storybook art style, not anime.
UI: just tiny "2/3" near the top center, subtle "Пропустить" at top right, and ONE broad airy cream translucent rounded dialogue surface near the bottom with generous margins. This surface occupies about 15–17% height. Label "Тиш" in small teal bold sans; beneath it the EXACT Russian line in dark forest charcoal modern humanist sans:
"Но праздник здесь…"
Small thin right-pointing continuation chevron at the right of the same surface, no large additional button, no other text. Match the first dialogue mockup's cream/teal/forest colors and soft corners. Text must stay high contrast. Important character faces, bird and lens must remain unobstructed. Screen should feel spacious despite the expressive story composition.
Avoid: three panels, two copies of Tish, portrait badges, heavy wood frames, ornate serif typography, extra story text, title bars, gameplay HUD or move controls, photoreal humans, neon/glass UI, watermark, device frame.
